description: Family board vectors (ADR-0033). 'ok' is what the server does when the cases are sent in order by one parent device that holds the parents key at epoch 1; 'schema' is whether JSON Schema accepts the message. A conflict or scope refusal is schema-valid: it depends on what the server already stores. Cases with direction 'server' are frames the server sends; a client sending them is refused. Both the Kotlin gateway tests and the Python checker replay this file.

cases.name: board.op appends a parents op at the held epoch
a replayed board.op is acked as a duplicate
a board.op reusing an op id with another body is a conflict
a parents op under an epoch the device does not hold is refused
a family op under a key epoch other than 0 is refused
a board.op in an unknown scope is refused
a board.op without ct is refused
a board.op whose ct is not base64 is refused

body.ct: this is not base64 at all, it has spaces!!
